subject.title: Feature: per-channel announce suppression for sub-agents

question: Which public completion-delivery primitive should OpenClaw expose for sub-agent announcements: per-channel suppression, global/per-spawn policy, parent/internal target, hook, or unified audience policy?
rationale: The code lacks the requested capability, but the durable API shape overlaps several open reports and would affect config, sessions_spawn, routing, fallback delivery, and user-visible channel behavior.

options.title: Unified completion-delivery policy
options.body: Expose one backward-compatible policy that covers channel suppression, internal-only parent delivery, and fallback behavior without creating competing primitives.

options.title: Narrow per-channel suppression
options.body: Add only a channel-level suppression rule and leave parent routing, hooks, and per-spawn policy to separate follow-up items.

options.title: Defer to broader hook or audience work
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for a broader event-audience or post-completion hook design to own the primitive.

recommendation.title: Unified completion-delivery policy
recommendation.body: Expose one backward-compatible policy that covers channel suppression, internal-only parent delivery, and fallback behavior without creating competing primitives.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the central announce behavior and delivery helper split where this product decision would likely be implemented or reviewed.
